title: Analogue 3D adds Wi-Fi firmware updates
excerpt: The modern Nintendo 64 console from Analogue can now download firmware updates directly over Wi-Fi, removing the need for memory cards.
body_html:
The Analogue 3D console, which is a modernized version of the Nintendo 64, now supports automatic updates over Wi-Fi. Previously, installing firmware updates for the company's hardware required users to manually transfer files using a memory card.

While the console has featured Wi-Fi capabilities, the functionality for direct updates has now been activated, streamlining the process of expanding the device's features and functionality.
